tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Card and logo-tile fill on `paper`; slide ground when Grow Wings presents alone; text on `navy` and `teal-deep`.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Default slide ground; chip fill; text on `navy`.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The Grow Wings colour: the mark, cover titles, footer bars, portrait discs, ticks and bullets. As text on `white` or `paper` it is 3.4:1, so keep it to 24px and larger (or bold 19px+); white on `teal` likewise.

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Day-card headers; eyebrows, tab labels, pillar titles, captions and footers on `paper` or `white` (5.1:1 and up). Text on it is `paper` or `white`.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Pill tags; thin rules on `paper`, `white` and `navy`; highlighted words in a headline on `navy`. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The Aquila colour: cover, section, testimonial and closing slide ground; stat blocks, stat pills, portrait discs, eyebrow square. Text on it is `white`, `paper`, `butter` or `mist`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All headings and body copy on `paper`, `white` and `mist`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1.5px outline of idle tabs and chips. Decorative: 1.4:1 on `white`, so never the only cue.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: The one warm accent: tagline box on a light cover (text `ink`); cover title on `navy`.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Active tab; first segment of the closing bar. The source sets white labels on it at 2.1:1; that pair is kept as is and fails contrast.

styles.name: cover
styles.usage: Cover title: `teal` on `white` or `paper`, `butter` on `navy`. First line may be bold italic.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Programme name on a case-study slide; section and closing headlines in `white` on `navy`.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Headline numbers. In a `navy` stat block use 45px.

styles.name: sub
styles.usage: Audience line under a programme name in `ink`; case-study line in `teal`.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Pillar title in `teal-deep`; the name 'Grow Wings x Aquila' as a wordmark.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Building Industry-Ready Engineers for Tomorrow's Workforce
styles.usage: Cover sub-line in `paper` on `navy`; last line in 700.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Over 1.5 million engineering graduates every year.
styles.usage: Supporting paragraph beside a title; case-study rows; testimonials; pill tag labels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Technical knowledge aligned to industry expectations.
styles.usage: Card descriptions and people-card roles in `ink`; 700 for names and stat-block labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and day-card headers. Tab labels use it without tracking or caps. Tracking estimated by eye.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a title in `teal-deep`, after a `navy` square. The source spaces it with literal spaces; 0.2em approximates that.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Slide footer in `teal-deep`; 700 for chip labels and page numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between pill tags and between an eyebrow square and its text; height of the closing bar.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gutter between cards and between tabs (18 to 20px in the source).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of cards (23 to 28px in the source); gap from the tab row to the cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Left and right slide margin on the 1440 x 810 canvas (81px in the corporate deck).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: White cards, day cards and the tagline box (7 to 9px measured).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Navy stat blocks and small logo tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large logo tile on case-study slides.
